purpose: Determine whether the predeclared breeding-space x breeding-option crossover is structurally estimable within each species after frozen forcing-cohort selection and predictor missingness, without using demographic count magnitudes.

transforms.A: z within species of log1p(mapped_ice_free_area_ha_2000m), complete cases only
transforms.H: z within species of tier2_richness_2000m, complete cases only
transforms.R: z within species of log1p(elevation_relief_p90_p10_m_2000m), complete cases only
transforms.group: CCAMLR for ADPE; APBP region for CHPE and GEPE, inherited from Gate 2C

interpretation_rules: The crossover model contains group structure, A, H and A x H. R is tested separately first and enters only the secondary combined model, preserving the frozen predictor modeling order.
The secondary combined A + H + R + A x H condition number is reported but does not determine primary crossover eligibility.
Group eta-squared for A, H and R is descriptive confounding information, not an outcome-based selection rule.
If any species fails its crossover gate, the interaction is not used as a program-level primary cross-species claim; species-specific eligible results may remain bounded secondary evidence.
boundary: No demographic count magnitude, trend direction, fitted loading or site-trait association is used.
The four zero-AEI-cell sites remain missing for A and H and are not converted to ecological zeroes.
No alternative buffer radius or new predictor is searched to rescue the interaction.
